entities.name: Tamerlane (Timur)
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Turco-Mongol conqueror (1336–1405) who founded the Timurid Empire spanning from Anatolia to India. His campaigns killed an estimated 5% of the world population, yet he was also a patron of arts and architecture, making Samarkand one of the most magnificent cities of the medieval world.
